13/Dated: 08 September, 2025
I.A. No.11936 of 2025
1 .  Heard Mr. Rajeeva Sharma, learned senior counsel for the appellant.
However, none appears on behalf of the State.
2. The prayer for bail of the appellant was earlier dismissed as not pressed thrice in I.A. Nos. 2858 of 2020, 9516 of 2022 and in I.A. No.4200 of 2023.

3. The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 376 (A) B of the I.P.C. and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life with a fine of Rs.25,000/- for the offence under Section 376 (A) B of the I.P.C.
4.

Submission has been advanced by the learned senior counsel for the appellant that the appellant Pastar Charku Oraon @ Charku Oraon Aged ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41563923/
1 has been implicated only on account of enmity with respect to conversion.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. It has been submitted that the medical report does not support the factum of rape and the evidence of the victim who has been examined as P.W.1 is contradictory to the contents of the first information report.
It has further been submitted by the learned senior counsel that the appellant is in custody for six years.
6. It appears that the appellant is alleged to be have committed rape upon the four years old granddaughter of the informant.
The victim has been examined as P.W.1 in which she has categorically stated about the immoral act committed by the appellant.
It further appears from the medical report that further examination could not be done on account of the pain being suffered in her private parts by the victim.
7. Regard being had to the above, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail which stands rejected at this stage.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Amar/-
